content.title: About
content.content: Ready‑to‑heat mashed potato (NFS) is a fully prepared product made from selected potatoes that are steamed and pureed without artificial preservatives. It has a smooth, creamy flavor and soft texture, suitable as a side dish or a stand‑alone meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato is the fourth most produced agricultural crop worldwide after rice, wheat and corn.
Ready‑made mashed potatoes are widely used in cafeterias and restaurants to speed up service.
The NFS (Not From Scratch) concept means the product is ready to eat without any further preparation.
When stored properly, the mash retains a high amount of vitamin C and potassium.
Small amounts of vegetable oils are often added to improve flavor and mouthfeel.

items.title: Rich source of potassium
items.content: Potatoes are high in potassium, which supports normal heart function and muscle activity.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Mashed potato provides vitamin B6 and B3, important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: When not overloaded with added butter or oil, the mash contains little saturated fat.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The soft texture and pre‑cooking make it gentle on the digestive system, ideal for those with chewing difficulties.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates in the mash supply fast‑acting energy, useful for post‑exercise recovery.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some ready‑to‑heat versions contain added salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Allergy to additives
items.content: The product may contain dairy or vegetable oils that can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Shelf life
items.content: After opening, keep the mash refrigerated and consume within a few days to prevent bacterial growth.

items.title: Vitamin C loss
items.content: Vitamin C is heat‑sensitive, so processing and storage can reduce its levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the mash in the microwave or on the stovetop, stirring until smooth. Add butter, cheese, herbs or spices to taste. It works well as a side for meat or fish dishes or as a light standalone meal.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep it in an airtight container in the refrigerator and use within 3‑4 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
